beats.narration_text: Hi — I'm Sudhanva, with week four of the RL Environments project update: six learners, two worlds, and a test of who really carries together.

props.command: Run all six learners in both worlds for a million steps, and measure which ants actually carry pieces together.
output: grid, 1M steps: IPPO 11.75 · MAPPO 11.42 · VDN 5.51 · QMIX collapses
open space: IQL, blind to teammates, scores 7.82; MAPPO 7.91
paired carries: IPPO 73% · MAPPO 66% · IQL 61% · VDN 47%

beats.narration_text: Only paired carries show the ants work together. A high team score doesn't: in open space, one ant can drag a piece alone. This week we measured the pairs.

props.text:
A high team score shows
the ants work together

shot.visual_intent: Writer types the arriving framing ('A high team score shows'), strikes it, corrects to 'Only paired carries show'. Final text 8 words; line 1 the whole trigger so it fits 9:16.

beats.speed_reason: audio window >= 9 s (EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY LAW TIMING); 1.0 gave 8.96 s

beats.narration_text: On the grid, a piece moves only when two ants pull it the same way. IPPO and MAPPO carry nearly every piece. Both IQL variants forage only crumbs. VDN carries some; QMIX climbs, then collapses.

shot.new_visual_element: Grid team-food bars for all six learners (seeds 5/5/3/3/3/3) with pieces; then QMIX's own learning curves per seed
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: evidence/w4_film.json groups (honest/grid-*) and qmix_grid (metrics.csv, seeds 0-2)

show.event: a real 2-holder pull drawn as two arrows on one piece (grid rule: 2 pullers, same way)
bars: IQL 3.29, IQL-team 2.73 — tag 'crumbs only, 0 pieces'
QMIX bar 0.08 gives way to its three seed curves: s0 peaks 3.86 at 700k, s1 3.40 at 500k, both fall to about 0

beats.narration_text: In open space, IQL can't see its teammates, yet nearly matches MAPPO. So we counted paired pieces: two ants pulled it for at least half the distance it moved. IPPO pairs seventy-three percent; IQL-team, thirty-two. At three million steps, IPPO reaches ten point seven.

shot.new_visual_element: Team-food bars IPPO/MAPPO/IQL (IQL tagged 'blind to teammates'); paired-share bars for five learners; IPPO's 3M curve
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: w4_film.json groups (honest/free-*: team, paired_share_s0_2) and long_free_ippo (metrics.csv)

show.event: food bars: IPPO 8.49, MAPPO 7.91, IQL 7.82 ('blind to teammates')
definition card: 'paired: 2+ ants pulled it for at least half the distance it moved'
paired-share bars: IPPO 73%, MAPPO 66%, IQL 61%, VDN 47%, IQL-team 32% (seeds 0-2)
IPPO free-world curve to 3M (seeds 0-2), end label '10.69 at 3M'

beats.narration_text: Two holders see the same view. IPPO and MAPPO holders pull the same way on over nine steps in ten, nearly always homeward. Most failed pulls are a lone ant pulling while it waits. In one MAPPO seed, direction depends on ant ID; agreement drops to seventy-eight percent.

shot.new_visual_element: 'identical view: 100% of co-holding steps'; per-seed agreement dots (IPPO 5, MAPPO 5) with MAPPO s3 ringed; stalled-pull split; MAPPO s3 x-share by ant ID
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: w4_film.json coordination + coordination_summary (coordinator's replay of scripts/coordination.py)

per-seed dots: IPPO .89–.99 (mean .94), MAPPO .78–.99 (mean .93); toward the nest .93–1.00
bars, steps per episode: a lone holder pulling 9.9 (IPPO) / 12.7 (MAPPO) vs holders pulling apart 0.6 / 1.4
MAPPO s3 ringed at .78; its x-share by ant ID 0.76 · 0.65 · 0.42 · 0.89 vs IPPO s0 0.42–0.45

beats.narration_text: For MAPPO, one value output per ant matches IPPO on the grid; the team reward alone roughly halves its open-space score.

shot.new_visual_element: Two small bar groups (grid, open space): default, team reward only, one value output per ant; IPPO reference line on the grid
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: w4_film.json groups credit-team/*, critic-per-ant/*, honest/*-mappo seeds 0-2 (RESULTS.md §7)

show.event: grid bars: default 11.48, per-ant outputs 11.75 = IPPO's 11.75 line
open-space bars: default 7.85 vs team reward only 4.14

beats.narration_text: Verdict: on the grid, IPPO and MAPPO carry together. Next week: why QMIX collapses, and the test we promised — hiding one holder's home vector.

artifactLines: Grid, 1M steps: IPPO 11.75 and MAPPO 11.42 of 12, nearly every piece carried by pairs.
Open space: paired carries IPPO 73%, MAPPO 66%, IQL 61%, VDN 47%, IQL-team 32%.
Holders see the same view and pull the same way on 93–94% of grid steps.
Next: why QMIX collapses · hide one holder's home vector (promised, not yet run).
